name: 2. Two pockets for the 1 with different routes to the 2

expected.why: Both pockets are makeable: bottom-left corner 27 degree cut (model make 12/12), bottom side 19 degree cut (11/12). Plain strokes into the corner never leave a green or amber shot on the 2 (best grade 0); 2 plain strokes into the side leave the 2 green. Expected: the bottom side pocket (pocket 1).
